item.title: Windows POS 1.0.40+52
item.description:
Windows POS 1.0.40+52
- Fix Summary waiting until "local summary is still syncing" even when Firestore already has the same cached data. - Listen for server-confirmation metadata events for order, payment and payment-correction backups. - On the first confirmed server snapshot, persist all returned documents before marking the local summary ready. An empty change list no longer skips the initial backup. - Keep later updates incremental and preserve the existing Yorba/Lido combined summary.
Includes the receipt batch, transaction-count and photo-viewing improvements from 1.0.39+51.
